title: Counting in four
summary: Two numbers at the start of the music say how to count.

steps.title: Time signature
steps.body:
Written music starts with two stacked numbers called the **time signature**. The top number is how many beats are in a bar. The bottom number says which note gets one beat.

**Why it matters:** It tells you how to count before you play a note, so the strong beats land in the right place.

The most common time signature is **4/4**: four beats in a bar, each one a quarter note. It is so common it is also called common time.

**Why it matters:** Almost all pop, rock and hip hop is in 4/4. If you are not sure how a song counts, try four.

steps.title: Reading 4/4
steps.body: Top 4: four beats in each bar. Bottom 4: each beat is a quarter note.

items.prompt: How many beats are in a bar of 4/4?

steps.title: Feel the four
steps.body: Tap 4/4 with your left hand and play a C chord with your right on every ONE.
